observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black smartphone held in hand, screen off, reflecting surroundings. No visible brand or model text on screen or bezel.
Photo 1: Side profile of the phone showing volume buttons, power button, and a flat edge design. No visible branding or model text.
Photo 2: Back view of the phone with Apple logo, triple-camera system in a large square module, and a green sticker reading '256 GB' and '15 Pro Max'. The phone appears to be dark gray or black.
All photos have a watermark 'TSQUARE GADGET PLUG' and 'POSTED ON Jiji'.
The green sticker on photo 2 is handwritten and placed over the camera module, not part of the phone's design.

claims.evidence: The green sticker in photo 2 says '256 GB' and '15 Pro Max', but this is a handwritten sticker, not an official label. No model or brand is visible on the phone itself in any photo. The design (triple camera, flat edges) is consistent with iPhone 15 Pro Max, but not definitive without a visible model number or screen.
No photo shows the SIM tray or settings screen. The presence of a physical SIM slot cannot be confirmed from the exterior photos alone.

risks.risk: The phone may not be an iPhone 15 Pro Max; it could be a counterfeit or a different model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the phone's screen showing the model name in Settings > General > About, or a photo of the model number on the back near the Apple logo or on the SIM tray.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic smartphone or lower-tier iPhone model

risks.risk: The phone may be damaged or have screen issues (e.g., cracked screen, dead pixels, touch problems).
risks.proof: A video or photo of the screen turned on, showing full functionality and no damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with screen damage

risks.risk: The phone may be locked to a carrier or have activation issues.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the phone turned on, showing the home screen and settings, with no carrier lock or activation lock message.

risks.risk: The phone may have water damage or internal issues not visible externally.
risks.proof: A photo of the phone's serial number and IMEI, and a video of the phone being powered on and used for calls, camera, and apps.

proof_requests: Photo of the phone's screen turned on, showing the model name in Settings > General > About.
Photo of the phone's back near the Apple logo or SIM tray showing the model number.
Video of the phone being powered on and used for calls, camera, and apps.
Photo of the SIM tray to confirm physical SIM slot.
response.reason: The identity of the phone is not confirmed by visible branding or model text; the only evidence is a handwritten sticker. Key claims like model, storage, and SIM capability cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks include counterfeit, damage, or lock status. Proof is needed to establish the true identity and condition before pricing.
